content: क्षिप्र {%a.%} [क्षिप्-रक्] (<ab>compar.</ab> क्षेपीयस्; <ab>superl.</ab> क्षेपिष्ठ) .²1 Elastic (as a bow); ऋतज्येन क्षिप्रेण ब्रह्मणस्पतिः <ls>Rv. 2. 24. 8</ls>. .²2 Quick, speedy. .{@-प्रम्@} .²1 A measure of time = ¹⁄₁₅ of a Muhūrta. .²2 The part of the hand between the thumb and the forefinger and the corresponding part of the foot. .{@-प्रम्@} {%ind.%} Quickly, speedily, immediately; विनाशं व्रजति क्षिप्रमामपात्रमिवाम्भसि <ls>Ms. 3. 179</ls>; <ls>Śānti. 3. 6</ls>; <ls>Bk. 2. 44</ls>.
